title: Asymptotic Gaussian boundary equivalence
statement: As $q\to\infty$ through the natural numbers, the Gaussian boundary associated with $q$ is asymptotically equivalent to $\frac{1}{q+2}\sqrt{2\log(q+2)}$; that is, their ratio tends to $1$.
